pattern.description: After the countdown lands on '5 DAYS TO PRODUCTION', a hairline green outline around the card thickens outward into a bold rounded green frame while the white card inside settles slightly smaller, marking the metric as achieved.
pattern.why_premium: A single colour-and-weight change signals success without new copy or icons; the border grows outward around a stable card, so the number stays legible while the frame adds emphasis and a brand-green payoff.

build_hint.gsap: Frame as a rounded rect behind the card: gsap.fromTo('.success-frame', {padding: 1, borderRadius: 40}, {padding: 28, borderRadius: 64, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); simultaneously gsap.to('.card', {scale: 0.96, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.inOut'}). Alternative: animate box-shadow '0 0 0 1px #3BD67A' -> '0 0 0 28px #3BD67A'.
build_hint.remotion: const p = interpolate(frame, [start, start + 12], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); frame inset = interpolate(p, [0, 1], [1, 28]) px around the card; card scale = interpolate(p, [0, 1], [1, 0.96]).

notes: Pattern 'other': spotlight_focus was the nearest canonical id but no dimming/isolation happens; this is a border-weight swell. The card/number shrink is slight and could be a perspective of the frame growing; camera verdict none.
